name: ClipWaltz
oneLiner: Turn your photos, clips, product links and ideas into beat-synced videos, image ads, carousels and memes — ready to post.
description: ClipWaltz is a cloud video maker with two tools. AutoWaltz turns your own photos and videos into a music video that cuts on the beat, with licensed music, templates and HD rendering done on ClipWaltz's servers. It also handles Insta360 360° footage, keeping the horizon level and following the action. Waltz AI creates brand-new video clips from a description or a photo, which you can enhance, arrange into scenes and export. Since November 2026 it also makes static image ads, carousels and memes (Waltz Image), builds ad packs from a product link or a Shopify / WooCommerce catalog, exports image ads for Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads Editor, installs as a phone/desktop app (PWA), and offers a Pro public API and MCP server. A full social publishing suite (scheduling, calendar, autopublishing, analytics, approvals) is built and in admin-only preview, not yet open to customers.
audience: Travel and event recap creators: people back from a trip, wedding, birthday or concert with hundreds of photos and clips they'll never edit by hand.
icp: Individual creators and casual posters (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) using a desktop browser, often with a phone or Insta360 camera. Expansion: real-estate agents, small-business product promos, coaches and creators, sports parents, and marketing teams needing frequent on-brand videos (Pro, workspaces).
painPoints: Editing apps are still work: sorting, trimming and syncing hundreds of clips takes hours.
Auto-videos get muted or taken down over unlicensed music.
360° footage (Insta360) needs desktop software to turn into a normal, shareable video.
desiredOutcome: A polished, postable music video in about a minute from raw footage, safe to publish, without learning an editor.
differentiators: Cloud rendering on ClipWaltz servers, not the user's device
A real auto-edit: beat-synced cuts, smart trim, Waltz to the Music pacing
Licensed music catalog that's safe to post
Insta360 support: split-lens pairs stitched, gyro horizon levelling, Front / Follow action / Tiny planet views
Waltz AI clip generation on self-hosted GPUs, in the same project as your own footage
Waltz AI Remix: AI lead-ins, living moments and extensions woven into your own finished videos, on the beat
Waltz Image draws ad text on the server, never by the AI model, so words are pixel-exact and edits are free
competitors: Manual editing in a video editor

features.name: AutoWaltz auto-edit
features.whatItDoes: Assembles uploaded photos and videos into a music video with beat-synced cuts, smart trim, motion, transitions, filters, titles and fades.
features.benefit: A finished video without editing.

features.name: Instant draft preview
features.whatItDoes: Plays the whole cut in the editor before rendering.
features.benefit: See and tweak it before committing.

features.name: Cloud HD render
features.whatItDoes: Renders 1080p 9:16 or 16:9 on ClipWaltz servers and notifies you (in-app, email, desktop) when ready.
features.benefit: Nothing to install; no waiting at the screen.

features.name: Licensed music catalog
features.whatItDoes: Curated royalty-free tracks by mood.
features.benefit: Safe to post, no takedowns.

features.name: Occasion templates
features.whatItDoes: Trip, event/wedding, birthday and 'surprise me' starting points plus saved presets.
features.benefit: Start from a vibe that fits.

features.name: 360 camera support
features.whatItDoes: Converts Insta360 .insv/.insp files, stitches split-lens pairs, levels the horizon from the camera's gyro and reframes to Front, Follow action or Tiny planet.
features.benefit: Use 360 footage with no desktop software.

features.name: Waltz AI
features.whatItDoes: Text-to-video and image-to-video clips with style, camera, motion, length and quality controls.
features.benefit: Create shots you didn't film.

features.name: Waltz AI Remix
features.whatItDoes: Pick any video you've made and weave AI into it: an AI lead-in that flows into the first shot, moments where a frame comes alive in place, and an AI extension past the last frame, with the song carried on under the AI parts.
features.benefit: Turn a finished video into something new without re-editing it.

features.name: Enhance
features.whatItDoes: Clean, Smooth (frame interpolation), Sharp (AI upscale) and Max Quality (AI Restore).
features.benefit: Better-looking clips in one click.

features.name: Versions, compare & scenes
features.whatItDoes: Version history, side-by-side compare, and storyboard scenes assembled into one video.
features.benefit: Iterate and build longer stories.

features.name: Exports
features.whatItDoes: MP4 or WebM at native, 720p or 1080p.
features.benefit: Deliverables for any platform.

features.name: Share & community
features.whatItDoes: Share links, public feed, likes and comments, monthly theme challenge.
features.benefit: Get views and inspiration.

features.name: Post text
features.whatItDoes: AI-written description and hashtags for the post.
features.benefit: Ready to publish with copy and paste.

features.name: Workspaces
features.whatItDoes: Invite teammates with owner, admin, editor or viewer roles.
features.benefit: Team collaboration on projects.

features.name: Google Drive backup
features.whatItDoes: Backs up original uploads to the user's Google Drive.
features.benefit: Keep originals safe.

features.name: Waltz Image — image ads
features.whatItDoes: AI or uploaded picture with headline, subhead and button drawn crisply on top, at exact sizes for feed, story, link/ad card and Pinterest (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 1.91:1, 2:3); brand kit colours, fonts and logo.
features.benefit: Platform-ready ads and social graphics in minutes; text edits cost nothing.

features.name: Carousels
features.whatItDoes: 2–10 slide carousels (square or 4:5) with hook, value and CTA slides, brand templates free, AI backgrounds optional; download each slide or a ZIP.
features.benefit: Swipeable posts without a design tool.

features.name: Memes
features.whatItDoes: Four original meme layouts on your own or an AI picture; long text wraps and shrinks to fit.
features.benefit: On-brand memes with no third-party templates.

features.name: Product link → ad pack
features.whatItDoes: Paste a product page: ClipWaltz reads name, price and photo, then makes image ads in every chosen size plus a WaltzDeck video ad brief with a Shop-now button.
features.benefit: From a product URL to a set of ads in one step.

features.name: Store catalogs
features.whatItDoes: Connect a Shopify or WooCommerce store (public catalog, no key) and sync up to 250 products, then make an ad pack from any product. Wix connects with an API key (not yet tested against a live Wix store).
features.benefit: Ads for your whole catalog, kept in sync.

features.name: Export for Meta / Google Ads
features.whatItDoes: Pick image designs and download one ZIP with a Meta Ads Manager bulk-import CSV and a Google Ads Editor Performance Max CSV, images included, UTM-tagged, everything paused.
features.benefit: Upload ready-made ads to your ad accounts without retyping.

features.name: Brand / client workspaces
features.whatItDoes: Workspace switcher and New workspace: one per client or brand (Pro: up to 5), each with its own projects, images and brand kit.
features.benefit: Agencies keep every client separate.

features.name: Public API + MCP server (Pro)
features.whatItDoes: Per-workspace API keys with read / generate / publish scopes, OpenAPI 3.1 at /api/v1, and a remote MCP server at /mcp for AI assistants (images, post copy, posts). No video-render endpoints yet.
features.benefit: Automate content from your own tools or an AI assistant.

features.name: Installable app (PWA)
features.whatItDoes: Install ClipWaltz on a phone or desktop home screen, with an offline page and web push.
features.benefit: ClipWaltz one tap away, no app store.

features.name: Social publishing (admin-only preview)
features.whatItDoes: Built and on prod but not yet open to customers: post to 20+ networks, calendar, scheduling and queue, Auto Post rules, per-network AI copy and hashtags, suggested posting times, approvals with client review links, analytics and comments for Facebook / Instagram / Threads / Bluesky, Plan a week, competitor feeds, podcast hosting, explainer videos and Shorts.
features.benefit: Make it and post it from one place — once switched on.

deployment: linuxg1 (pm2 clipwaltz :3100 + generation worker + social worker) behind a Cloudflare Tunnel at www.clipwaltz.com (apex → www 308); render worker on the AI box; AI inference on AISERVER; image generation on the ComfyUI box; MinIO on linuxg7 with the media.clipwaltz.com edge

brand.voice: Warm, playful and confident (inferred from site copy: 'Let's Waltz', 'We waltz it', 'Done before your coffee'); confirm.
